name: Chicchai Idol DVD no Tsukurikata
original_name: ちっちゃいアイドルDVDのつくりかた
source:
Ayaka-chan shoots her first "image video".
Mommy goes off somewhere as soon as the camera starts rolling, leaving the director to do as he pleases!
Watch as she's goaded into inappropriate acts. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE141048.html]DLsite English[/url]]
